consent.title: Before you start: how your data is used
consent.intro: {company} uses WorkLog to keep attendance records. This notice explains what's recorded and your rights under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

collect.title: What's recorded
collect.body: Your profile (name, employee code, email, role, department, manager, office), each status change you make with its time, network address and computer, your daily summaries, and a check-in photo if {company} requires one.

notCollect.title: What's never recorded
notCollect.body: No keystrokes, screenshots, screen recording, browsing history or location tracking. The idle prompt only notices that this tab hasn't been used. It never records what you do.

purpose.title: Why
purpose.body: To record working hours, breaks and leave, so they can be approved and paid correctly. The data isn't used for any other purpose.

access.title: Who can see it
access.body: You, your reporting manager and {company}'s administrators. WorkLog staff access it only to provide support. Every access to a check-in photo by someone else is logged.

retention.title: How long it's kept
retention.body: Attendance records are kept as long as {company} must keep them by law. Check-in photos are deleted after {days} days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see everything recorded about you and download it at any time from My data. You can ask for corrections, and raise a grievance with {company}.

consent.accept: I have read this notice and agree
